findings.reason: the machinery was landed by the two feeder plans this endpoint dispatches, so naming the modules in §3 is prose correction, not a design change.
findings.text: §3 presents the comparator and the closed/open branch assembler as design components, but both now exist (nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:140 compare_closed_boundaries; nova/equilibrium/separatrix_branches.py:27 assemble_separatrix_branches), are already wired into both EFIT harnesses, and are cited by neither module reference in §3

findings.reason: a fail-closed gate scores a class that still has a second, forbidden producer; the plan should pin the comparator as sole authority (or re-scope the gate read) rather than hand the retirement off while scoring through it.
findings.text: ForwardTopologyState.diverted is still produced (topology.py:1364) and serialized into banked receipts while classify_boundary_mode (nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:29) is the class authority §3's gate declares it uses and forbids the legacy leaf — the duplicate producer sits inside this endpoint's own scored read path, and the plan defers its retirement to a foreign followup carrying no owner file

findings.reason: per the interface_budget rule the section must account in its own text for the public-definition and refusal-family surface it adds, or state why the per-harness comparison/refusal code cannot be retired; the current §3 text does not.
findings.text: §3 introduces a comparator (public names BoundaryMode, ClosedBoundaryComparison, classify_boundary_mode, compare_closed_boundaries) and a fail-closed gate with a new refusal family (missing_predicted_closed_boundary, missing_reference_closed_boundary, missing_achieved_topology_class, missing_predicted_saddle, missing_reference_x_points) without naming what it retires or merges; supplied counts are all 0

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — assemble_separatrix_branches (nova/equilibrium/separatrix_branches.py:27) and compare_closed_boundaries (nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:140) each hide substantial behaviour (fixed-capacity split-at-saddle branch assembly; arc-length symmetric sup/RMS plus class classification plus unordered X-point distance) behind one function each.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the achieved topology class has two live producers: the legacy ForwardTopologyState.diverted leaf (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:107, produced at topology.py:1364, still serialized in banked receipts) and classify_boundary_mode over class_margin (nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:29).
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §3 commits a new comparator public interface and a new gate refusal family without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3 names a "shared closed-boundary comparator" and a "fixed-capacity closed/open branch assembler over traced_spline_contour (the one missing contract)" without citing the modules that now own them; the §2 reuse map did perform the search, but §3's design text does not name what it extends or wires.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the design consolidates comparison into one shared comparator wired into both EFIT harnesses (benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:62, benchmarks/diiid_circuit_driven_forward_validation.py:51) rather than adding a parallel path; no wrapper lacking justification.
